Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+252D, which you can use as ┭ in HTML, \252D in CSS, or type with Alt+9517 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+252D is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ┭ or the hex escape ┭.

How to type box drawings left heavy and right down light on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 5 1 7 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9517.
  4. Release Alt. The Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light character (┭) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type box drawings left heavy and right down light on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light" and click the character to insert it.

How to use box drawings left heavy and right down light in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\252D"; ()
  • Python: \u252D or chr(0x252D)
  • JavaScript: \u252D or String.fromCodePoint(0x252D)
  • JSON: "\u252D"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ┭?

No legacy Alt code exists for Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+252D in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ┭ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ┭, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9517 not work?

Alt+9517 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light?

The Unicode codepoint for Box Drawings Left Heavy And Right Down Light is U+252D. You can use this value in HTML as ┭, in CSS as \252D, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ┭ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+252D, then click it.
